meta.name: session-skill-mining
meta.description: Use when the user explicitly asks to inspect past Codex or Claude Code sessions, runs, or chats from a specific time range and extract reusable upgrades (skills to codify, memories to pin, or strategy-shaped findings that can be represented as skills or memories). Also invoked by the auto-optimizer scheduler to produce structured JSON suggestions for the Auto-optimization route.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从过往对话中提炼可复用的技能和记忆
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果希望自动从聊天记录中总结最佳实践并改进智能体行为
copy.tagline_en: Extract reusable skills and memories from past conversations
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to automatically capture best practices from your chat history to improve agent behavior

howto.what: 装上后，Claude能审查用户指定时间范围内的AI编码会话（如Codex或Claude Code），从中提取可复用的工作模式作为技能，以及需要记住的项目或用户偏好作为记忆，并以结构化建议输出。
howto.when: 当用户要求检查过去特定时间段的编码会话、运行记录或聊天时触发。也可由自动优化调度器按计划调用。

say.text: 检查我上周的Claude Code会话，找出可复用的工作流。
say.note: Claude会扫描会话并识别技能和记忆。

say.text: 从昨天下午的编程对话中提取值得记住的项目偏好。
say.note: Claude会分析该时间段的会话并输出记忆候选。

say.text: 扫描过去三天的Codex会话，识别可以编写为技能的调试步骤。
say.note: Claude会提炼出可复用的调试流程。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude can review user-defined AI coding sessions (e.g., Codex or Claude Code) from a specified time range, extract reusable patterns as skills and durable facts as memories, and output structured JSON suggestions.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to inspect past coding sessions, runs, or chats from a specific time range. Also invoked by the auto-optimizer scheduler on a cron.

say_en.text: Review my Claude Code sessions from last week and find reusable workflows.
say_en.note: Claude scans sessions and identifies skill and memory candidates.

say_en.text: Extract project preferences worth remembering from yesterday afternoon's coding conversations.
say_en.note: Claude analyzes that time range and outputs memory candidates.

say_en.text: Scan the last three days of Codex sessions for debug steps that could be codified as a skill.
